pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 USE OF INTERROGATIVES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how much more..., when/who/why/what else with peers for example, who else attended the ceremony?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify interrogatives: how, what, when, why, who in sentences correctly
2. use interrogatives how much more..., when/who/why/what else accurately in sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives

Teach
• Focus skill: identify interrogatives: how, what, when, why, who in sentences correctly.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Use of Interrogatives
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how much more..., when/who/why/what else with peers for example, who else attended the ceremony?
2. how much more sugar was bought?
3. Why do we ask questions?
4. How do we ask questions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
